records.context: When only late widget blocks were registered since the sheet was composed, each application view already wears those blocks, rendered with these same values, so its local copy is kept and the application view is not restyled. Clearing the copies restyled every application view at once and again at its next show: 0.9 s on Home and 0.55-0.8 s per application view on an Intel Mac.

records.source: When only late widget blocks were registered since the sheet was composed, each screen already wears those blocks, rendered with these same values, so its local copy is kept and the screen is not restyled. Clearing the copies restyled every screen at once and again at its next show: 0.9 s on Home and 0.55-0.8 s per screen on an Intel Mac.
records.translation: Quando apenas blocos tardios de widgets foram registrados desde a composição da folha de estilo, cada tela já exibe esses blocos, renderizados com esses mesmos valores; por isso sua cópia local é mantida e a tela não é reestilizada. Limpar as cópias reestilizava todas as telas de uma vez e de novo na exibição seguinte: 0.9 s em Home e 0.55-0.8 s por tela em um Intel Mac.
